public_export_policy: Only project-transcribed or source-derived aggregate TSVs are committed. Official source files remain externally locatable and are represented by verified acquisition hashes.

sources.source_version: Braz. J. Food Technol. 29 e2025106 version of record
sources.title: Chemical, antioxidant, and sensory profiles of Indonesian single-origin Arabica coffee with different roast levels and brewing methods
sources.evidence_role: Ordinary-consumer RATA and liking across 12 observed origin-roast-preparation conditions
sources.limitations: Fifty naive consumers; aggregate means and standard deviations; RATA and hedonic scales remain separate.

sources.title: Metabolomics Combined with Sensory Analysis Reveals the Impact of Different Extraction Methods on Coffee Beverages from Coffea arabica and Coffea canephora var. Robusta
sources.evidence_role: Trained-panel medians for 20 source descriptors across two coffee species and four extraction methods
sources.limitations: Six panelists; source-scale medians only; no conversion to CATA, RATA, or a shared roast scale.

sources.title: Sensory profiles of Robusta coffee genetic resources from the Democratic Republic of the Congo
sources.evidence_role: Three-Q-grader sample profiles for 95 harvest/genotype records under source-reported medium-roast cupping
sources.limitations: One preparation family and source-defined broad descriptor classes; genotype and harvest are future grouping keys, not participant identities.
